D/ IMP CAES NERVA TRAIAN AVG [GERM] ; R/ PM TR P COS IIII P P

A complete silver denarius of the Roman period from the reign of Trajan (AD98-117). RIC II no. 54. The good is in good condition with small amounts of wear to both faces. There is possible clipping or abrasion to the edge in one area. Obverse description: Laureate bust right. Obverse inscription: IMP CAES NERVA TRAIAN AVG [GERM]. Reverse description: Abundantia seated left, holding sceptre.…
